min_x.description: lower x bound of the box, inclusive [m]

max_x.description: upper x bound of the box, inclusive [m]

min_y.description: lower y bound of the box, inclusive [m]

max_y.description: upper y bound of the box, inclusive [m]

min_z.description: lower z bound of the box, inclusive [m]

max_z.description: upper z bound of the box, inclusive [m]

negative.description: when false, keep the points inside the box; when true, keep the points outside it. Points with a non-finite x, y or z are dropped in both cases, because a NaN compares false against every bound and inverting that would let NaN through.

input_frame.description: the frame the bounds above are expressed in. This filter does not transform: a cloud whose header frame_id differs is dropped with an error, not re-cropped. Leave empty to accept any frame, which is only safe when the producer's frame is already known to match.
